# meraki_appliance_umbrella_account (Resource)

This resource allows connecting a Cisco Umbrella account to a network. Deleting the resource disconnects the account from the network. Changing the credentials replaces the resource; the account is disconnected and then connected again, and if connecting fails the network is left without an Umbrella account. The API has no way to read the connection, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and the resource cannot be imported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "meraki_appliance_umbrella_account" "example" {
  network_id = "N_24329156"
  api_key    = "1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678"
  api_secret = "abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) Network ID

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for the Umbrella account
- `api_key_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only attribute.
- `api_key_wo_version` (Number) Version of api_key_wo.
- `api_secret` (String, Sensitive) API secret for the Umbrella account
- `api_secret_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only attribute.
- `api_secret_wo_version` (Number) Version of api_secret_wo.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `umbrella_organization_id` (String) Umbrella organization ID returned when the account is connected
